cohort: The study included 863 women with breech presentation at term.
finding: While caesarean section was associated with higher maternal blood loss, attempted vaginal breech birth was associated with worse fetal outcomes, including lower Apgar scores, lower umbilical arterial pH, higher transfer rate to the NICU, and higher rate of respiratory support.
mod_finding: The failed attempt of vaginal breech birth was associated with significantly worse umbilical arterial pH.
